lyhna-mcp — Lyhna MCP proxy + capsule tools

  lyhna-mcp                 start the MCP proxy, Streamable HTTP (config via LYHNA_PROXY_* env)
  lyhna-mcp proxy           same, explicit
  lyhna-mcp stdio           start the MCP proxy over stdio (for MCP client config blocks)
  lyhna-mcp ctl --file <f>  send one supervisor control command from a JSON file (open/close/status/dump/...)
  lyhna-mcp export-pack     export a closed loop's full proof pack in one command
  lyhna-mcp handoff [dir]   print the paste-ready next-agent handoff from a proof pack
  lyhna-mcp post --pr <n>   post the pack's proof card to a GitHub PR (uses YOUR gh login)
  lyhna-mcp export …        package an existing receipts.json (see export-loop-proof usage)
  lyhna-mcp help            show this help

usage: lyhna-mcp handoff [pack-dir] [--md]
  Prints the paste-ready next-agent handoff prompt from an exported proof pack
  (default pack-dir: current directory). --md prints the full HANDOFF.md rendering.

usage: lyhna-mcp post --pr <number> [pack-dir] [--repo <owner/name>]
  Posts the pack's proof card (proof-card.md) as a comment on a GitHub pull request
  using YOUR OWN GitHub CLI credentials (`gh auth login`). Lyhna never holds a GitHub
  token. Default pack-dir: current directory.

usage: lyhna-mcp ctl --file <command.json>      (recommended — shell-quoting-safe, incl. PowerShell)
       lyhna-mcp ctl '<json-command>'
                [--socket <path> | --host <host> --port <port>]
  Sends ONE supervisor control command (open / amend / close / status / dump / dump_scope /
  dump_judgment / record_delta) to a standing lyhna-mcp proxy and prints the JSON response.
  Example: write {"cmd":"status"} to cmd.json, then: lyhna-mcp ctl --file cmd.json
  Defaults to LYHNA_PROXY_CONTROL_SOCKET / LYHNA_PROXY_CONTROL_HOST+PORT from the environment.

usage: lyhna-mcp export-pack --loop <loop_id> --out <dir> [--mode proof|verified-context]
                [--source-env <env>] [--socket <path> | --host <host> --port <port>]
  Reads a closed loop's sealed chain, scope history, and judgment ledger over the supervisor
  control channel, folds the continuation capsule, and writes the full proof pack (receipts,
  bundle, proof-card.md, HANDOFF.md, judgment ledger, memory-injection.json) to <dir>.
  Default --mode is the scope's sealed privacy_mode (downgrading to proof is always allowed).
